params.prompt: Create a single continuous 12-second photoreal shot connecting the opening close-up to the ending wide view. Preserve this exact actor David, glasses, navy blazer and striped shirt, and blue galaxy. Camera smoothly dollies backwards throughout. 0-1.5s David gazes upward. 1.5-3s he looks at the viewer with a subtle smug intellectual superiority, closed mouth. 3-4s he looks upward again and gracefully begins ascending. From 4s onwards camera widens to reveal exactly the SIX props in the final reference. CRITICAL MAIN ACTION: THE SIX EXISTING PROPS THEMSELVES TRAVEL ALL THE WAY AROUND DAVID. They are not stationary decorations. Each object continuously sweeps left-to-right, passes behind his body, comes around the other side, then crosses in front of his legs, on smooth closed elliptical trajectories centered on David's waist. Complete one full orbit between seconds 5 and 11, settling into final reference positions at 12. Use different tilted planes and staggered phases: toaster and microscope on a nearly horizontal orbit; cat and LED swimming cap on a diagonal orbit; heart love potion and gooseneck tabletop intercom on the opposite diagonal. Preserve six original objects, one of each, no other objects or copies. Their position changes must be large and unmistakable, exchanging sides of David several times. Perspective depth: objects on the far half disappear briefly BEHIND David, then emerge on the opposite side; objects on the near half pass in FRONT of his lower body with realistic occlusion. Keep David's face clear. They move as rigid recognizable physical objects, no morphing. The camera does not orbit: only the objects travel around the central man. The whole group ascends while camera pulls away, until David is small high at center as in end reference. Think a graceful choreographed planetary ballet: six existing inventions circulating around a central person. THERE ARE NO DRAWN ORBIT PATHS, no rings, lines, strings, balls, atomic graphic overlays, trails attached to objects, or diagrams. The trajectories are INVISIBLE; only the six props move. Do not add anything to illustrate motion. No duplicate cat or duplicate prop; no stationary copies left behind. Same quiet dark navy and sky-blue background, no cuts or transitions, no wings, no text, no UI, no audio. Identity stability and genuine orbital translation are the highest priorities.
